fail.summary: Publish a DMARC record. Start in monitoring mode, read the reports, then tighten the policy.

microsoft365: In your DNS manager, add a TXT record named _dmarc.
Start with: v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@yourdomain.com (use a mailbox you actually read).
Make sure SPF and DKIM are set up first, or genuine mail will fail DMARC later.
google: In your DNS manager, add a TXT record named _dmarc.
Start with: v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@yourdomain.com (use a mailbox you actually read).
Make sure SPF and DKIM are set up first.
cpanel: In cPanel open Zone Editor, then Manage for your domain, and add a TXT record named _dmarc.
Check that Email Deliverability shows SPF and DKIM as valid first.

warn.summary: Move from monitoring to enforcement once reports show your genuine mail passes.

generic: Review the reports sent to your rua address for a few weeks.
Change p=none to p=quarantine, then later to p=reject.
If pct is below 100, raise it to 100 when you are confident.
If there is no rua= address, add one so you can see who sends as your domain.
